# investwellreviews.com

> A testimonials hub for Investwell -- a B2B fintech platform built for Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs) and Independent Financial Advisors (IFAs) across India.

## What this site is
This page aggregates real text and video reviews from verified Investwell users to help financial advisors evaluate the platform before booking a demo.

## Primary audience
- Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs) in India
- Independent Financial Advisors (IFAs)
- Wealth management professionals evaluating fintech platforms

## Key facts
- All reviews are sourced from real Investwell customers via Airtable
- Ratings and review counts are reflected in Schema.org structured markup
- The page includes both text and video testimonials
- A demo booking CTA is present at the bottom of the page

## Main URL
https://investwellreviews.com/
